get_character.description: Get everything recorded about one Naruto character by id or by name: pictures, debut, family, jutsu, chakra natures, clan, village, team, rank, tools and voice actors. A name is matched ignoring case and accents, whole or in part, but must fit one character; otherwise the step fails naming those it fits. No API key required.

occupation: Third Division Commander of the Allied Shinobi Forces

anime.description: Their first anime episode, e.g. 'Naruto Episode #1', or null.

appearsIn.description: The media they appear in, e.g. ['Anime', 'Manga', 'Game'].

game.description: Their first video game, or null.

manga.description: Their first manga chapter, e.g. 'Naruto Chapter #1', or null.

family.description: The character's relatives, as the wiki lists them.

relation.description: How they are related, e.g. 'father' or 'adoptive son'.

id.description: The character's id, e.g. 1344 for Naruto Uzumaki. Get a character and Get several characters take it.

image.description: A link to the character's first picture on the Naruto Fandom wiki, or null when there is none.

images.description: Links to every picture of the character, often one per era.

jutsu.description: The techniques the character uses, e.g. 'Rasengan'.

natureType.description: The character's chakra natures, e.g. 'Wind Release (Affinity)'.

personal.description: Personal details. A detail the wiki does not give is null or empty.

affiliation.description: The villages and organisations they belong to, e.g. 'Konohagakure'.

era.description: The part of the story the value is for, such as 'Part I', 'Part II', 'Blank Period', 'Gaiden' or 'Boruto Manga', or null when the wiki names none.

value.description: The value then, as the wiki writes it.

classification.description: What kind of ninja they are, e.g. 'Sensor Type'.

height.description: Their height in each era, e.g. '166cm'.

kekkeiMora.description: Their kekkei mora, e.g. 'All-Killing Ash Bones'.

status.description: 'Deceased', 'Presumed Deceased' or 'Incapacitated', or null when the wiki records none.

list_teams.description: List the 191 Naruto teams, squads and groups, such as Team Kakashi and Taka, with how many characters belong to each, optionally only those whose name contains some text. No API key required.
list_teams.name: list_teams

parameters.description: Only teams whose name contains this, ignoring case and accents (for example, kakashi finds Team Kakashi). Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: name

id.description: The team's id, which Get a team takes.

member_count.description: How many characters belong to it.

list_villages.description: List the 39 Naruto villages and places characters are affiliated with, such as Konohagakure, with how many characters belong to each, optionally only those whose name contains some text. No API key required.
list_villages.name: list_villages

parameters.description: Only villages whose name contains this, ignoring case and accents (for example, gakure finds the hidden villages). Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: name

id.description: The village's id, which Get a village takes.

member_count.description: How many characters belong to it.

search_characters.description: Search the 1,430 Naruto and Boruto characters by name, affiliation, clan, team, kekkei genkai, chakra nature, jutsu, classification, ninja rank or sex, a page at a time with the real total. Every text filter matches any part of a value and ignores case and accents. Characters with the most jutsu come first, so the best known lead. No API key required.

debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow
Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie
debut.novel: Akatsuki Hiden: Evil Flowers in Full Bloom
debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

titles: itachiOfTheSharingan(写輪眼のイタチ,SharinganNoItachi,LiterallyMeaning:ItachiOfTheCopyWheelEye)clanKillerItachi(一族殺しのイタチ,IchizokugoroshiNoItachi)

search_characters.name: search_characters

parameters.description: Only characters whose name contains this, ignoring case and accents (for example, uchiha finds Sasuke Uchiha, and hyuga finds Hinata Hyuga, whom the API spells with an accent).
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only characters affiliated with a village or organisation whose name contains this, such as Konohagakure, konoha or Akatsuki.
parameters.name: affiliation

parameters.description: Only characters of a clan whose name contains this, such as Uchiha or Hyuga. The word clan is ignored, so Hyuga Clan and Hyuga are the same.
parameters.name: clan

parameters.description: Only characters on a team whose name contains this, such as Team Kakashi or Taka.
parameters.name: team

parameters.description: Only characters with a kekkei genkai whose name contains this, such as Sharingan, Byakugan or Wood Release.
parameters.name: kekkei_genkai

parameters.description: Only characters with a chakra nature whose name contains this, such as Fire Release or lightning.
parameters.name: nature_type

parameters.description: Only characters with a jutsu whose name contains this, such as Rasengan or Chidori.
parameters.name: jutsu

parameters.description: Only characters classified as this or something containing it, such as Jinchuriki, Sage, Sensor Type, Missing-nin or Medical-nin.
parameters.name: classification

parameters.description: Only characters who held this ninja rank at any point in the story, such as Kage.
parameters.name: rank

parameters.description: Only characters of this sex. Other finds the few recorded as neither male nor female; characters with no sex recorded never match.
parameters.name: sex

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. Leave empty for the first page. A page past the last one returns no characters, but still gives the real total.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many characters a page holds, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: page_size

characters.description: This page of the characters that match, those with the most jutsu first. Empty when nothing matches or the page is past the last one.

description: Look up Naruto characters, clans, villages, teams, kekkei genkai, tailed beasts, the Akatsuki and Kara with the free, keyless Dattebayo API: 1,430 characters from the Naruto and Boruto anime, manga, novels, films and games, each with their jutsu, chakra natures, family, clan, village, team, ninja rank and voice actors, taken from the Naruto Fandom wiki. It serves the same collections the NarutoDB API published before narutodb.xyz went offline. No account or API key required.
